items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It contacts through Bill Cray, you know. I didn't know that. I didn't know that. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he's the one that tipped him off. Really?

ctx.x: Well, we got this letter. I mean, they want us to go to Rome now. Well, it's going to be a similar deal. And we also supposed to go to Washington, D.C., February 27th for the, they got this Congressional Carnival Ball over there. And we supposed to play for that. So we keep an active just enough to, you know, keep in shape, you know. Do you rehearse? Huh? Do you rehearse? Well, I'll tell you, there's rumor that we're getting ready to make a record for the Louisiana Historical Society. Now, this, this fella made a…
It contacts through Bill Cray, you know. I didn't know that. I didn't know that.
Yeah, he's the one that tipped him off. Really?
